text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm passing by the central
plaza...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe. What a sweetheart you are.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that tickles! ♪ So this is what it's
like to
get a pat on the head!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my! You must be—
choice_data_list: ファインがなでなでされている……！？
choice_data_list_en: Fine is getting patted on the head...?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hi, Trainer! Hehehe, nice to see you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Exactly what it looks like. This is Fine's
pampering
time.
choice_data_list: えっと……何をやってるんだ？
えっと……何をやってるの？
choice_data_list_en: Um... what are you up to?
Um... what are you up to?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
She's always working so hard, what with
all that
studying, racing, and her duties.
So she must be
spoiled in kind.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate your consideration,
Creek. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wish to honor the tenderness you've
shown me...
So I'll give you a pat in
return! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my, what's this?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
This is your time to be spoiled. Just
surrender
yourself to my care, dear.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You must be tired from all those
documents you
were just writing. Why
don't I give you a firm hand
massage?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I can't believe you even notice
little things
like that!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
However, my stay here in Japan is
partially
conditional on my performance
of those tasks, so
they don't feel
bothersome at all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to studying alongside you
as a
student of this academy, Creek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion takes the hand Super Creek

extended in her attempted massage and
gives her
a firm handshake.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Um, yes, I feel the same...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek continues her attempts to
spoil Fine
Motion afterward, but...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It seems like you're having fun, Fine, but
I get the
feeling that you still need more
pats.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You need to take advantage of your
academy
life. I think it's quite all right to
take a break from
time to time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There's no problem with forgetting
about
everything else and letting your
hair down on
occasion, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thanks, both of you! But, you
see...
choice_data_list: 確かに息抜きは大事だな
確かに息抜きは大事だね
choice_data_list_en: True, taking a breather is important.
True, taking a breather is important.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm already quite spoiled. The very fact
that I'm
allowed to be here right now is
proof of that.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I get to run in the races I love so much,
and I've
been able to experience all
kinds of thrills and
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You know, like the tastiness of cup
ramen! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's right. That does sound like the
very best
way to spoil her.
choice_data_list: じゃあとことん『今』を楽しもう！
だったらもっと甘えさせたい！
choice_data_list_en: Then let's enjoy the here and now to the fullest!
Then I want to pamper you even more!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Let's all make loads and loads of
wonderful
memories together! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Is there something you want to do right
now?
Anything that's caught your eye or
a place you
want to visit? Please tell
us! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... There are so many things, to
tell the
truth.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Really? Then first, I'd like to peruse the
food
section in the department store!
There's a
seasonal dessert fair on right
now! ♪
choice_data_list: いいよ、全部やってみよう！

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Then, let's go! And after, you can tell us
the next
thing you want to do.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we accompany Fine Motion on
various
endeavors for the remainder of
the day, enjoying
each moment as it
comes.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Today was so fun! I'll never forget it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
After all, none of this would have
happened
without you two being here,
making those
decisions with me in the
moment. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion gazes into the distance, as
if to see
Ireland beyond the horizon.
Looking at her, I'm
filled with the desire
to help her create as many
memories as
possible.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, precisely! We'll teach you the true
meaning
of being pampered.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You're both so kind. I already feel like
I'm being
spoiled by your consideration
alone.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Come now, this is exactly what I'm
talking about.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it's going to be, I'll just
have to roll
up my sleeves and really
show you a pampering!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how exciting! Sounds like this will
be an
experience to remember.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Certainly, this will be an experience I
can only
have here with you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion gazes into the distance, as
if to see
Ireland beyond the horizon.
Looking at her, I'm
filled with the desire
to help her create as many
memories as
possible.
